Title: Account Management
Description: Create, modify, review, disable, and remove system accounts so only authorized identities have access.
Typical Evidence: Joiner/mover/leaver SOP; account inventory; periodic access-review records

Title: Access Enforcement
Description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access by users and processes. Apply least-privilege and role-based access principles.
Typical Evidence: RBAC matrix; ACL/group-policy exports; deny-by-default config evidence

Title: Use of External Systems
Description: Set terms for use of external/personal systems and cloud services that touch specified information.
Typical Evidence: Acceptable-use policy; approved-SaaS list; BYOD/MDM config

Title: Publicly Accessible Content
Description: Control what is posted to public-facing systems so specified information is never exposed.
Typical Evidence: Content-review workflow; designated approvers list; periodic public-site scans

Title: User Identification and Authentication
Description: Uniquely identify and authenticate every user before granting access.
Typical Evidence: IdP/directory records of unique accounts; policy banning shared accounts; authentication logs

Title: Device Identification and Authentication
Description: Identify and authenticate devices before they connect to systems handling specified information.
Typical Evidence: Device inventory; 802.1X/cert-based NAC config; MDM enrolment records

Title: Multifactor Authentication
Description: Require MFA for privileged accounts and for remote/network access to systems handling specified information.
Typical Evidence: MFA enrolment report from IdP; conditional-access policies; enforcement-scope screenshot

Title: Media Sanitization
Description: Sanitize or destroy media containing specified information before disposal, release, or reuse.
Typical Evidence: Sanitization SOP referencing NIST SP 800-88 or CCCS ITSP.40.006; destruction certificates; disposal log

Title: Physical Access Authorizations
Description: Maintain a list of authorized personnel for facilities housing systems with specified information. Issue and revoke credentials accordingly.
Typical Evidence: Authorized-personnel roster; badge-issuance log; termination revocation records

Title: Physical Access Control
Description: Enforce physical access at entry/exit points (locks, badges, guards, escorts for visitors).
Typical Evidence: Badge-reader logs; visitor log with escort signatures; documentation of controlled entry

Title: Boundary Protection
Description: Monitor, control, and protect communications at external boundaries and key internal boundaries.
Typical Evidence: Firewall rule export; network diagram with trust zones; egress filtering config

Title: Flaw Remediation
Description: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner.
Typical Evidence: Vulnerability-scan reports; patch SLA policy; patch-deployment evidence (WSUS/Intune/Jamf)

Title: Malicious Code Protection
Description: Deploy and maintain malicious-code protection on endpoints and gateways.
Typical Evidence: AV/EDR console coverage; definition-update logs; detection/quarantine records
